entries.title: After an upgrade from an older version, the release note lists every recorded change
entries.body: Versions before alpha 0.1.28-alpha.23 did not record what you had seen, so that upgrade showed no release note. Now the first launch after such a version puts one note on top of your cards with every recorded change, grouped by release. If you already ran alpha 0.1.28-alpha.23, you get that note once, on your next upgrade.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.
